english_text: The battle draws to a close!
We will not surrender! We will fight again!
I will not be beaten! Come kinsmen!
We are capturing the enemy base!
The fight for freedom never ends!
Glory to the gods! This day is ours!
czech_text: Sláva bohům! Tento den je náš!

english_text: The Roman Beast Germanicus is dead!
WE ARE FIRING ON OUR ALLIES!
A glorious victory will soon be ours!
I fight to defend the weak!
Cease fire! We're attacking our allies!
Our kinsmen return to the battle!
czech_text: Naši soukmenovci se vracejí do boje!

english_text: We have slain the mighty Vercingetorix!
Stop! We're firing on Allied troops!
I will fight to my last breath!
We are beaten but never defeated!
Time grows short! We will fight till the last!
czech_text: Času je málo! Budeme bojovat do posledního!

english_text: Claim the enemy base or kill them all!
czech_text: Vezměte jim základnu, nebo je pobijte!

english_text: The Roman dog Scipio is dead!
Time is running out! We must end this!
czech_text: Dochází nám čas! Musíme to ukončit!

english_text: The tyrant Caesar is dead at last!
We have claimed victory and their base!
We will never bow to tyrants!
Up! We have no time for weakness!
We have killed the enemy commander!
Their base is in our hands!
czech_text: Jejich základna je v našich rukou!

english_text: Our base is in enemy hands!
czech_text: Naše základna je v rukou nepřítele!

english_text: The gods be praised! Arminius is dead!
